Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill the two Sitar Heroes in the Mutanous Malaise, Level 2, and return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Sitar Hero - Co-op

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill the two Sitar Heroes in the Mutanous Malaise, Level 2, and return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

We got a new problem with the creatures and Sitar Hero. It looks like they discovered that they could join forces and play Co-Op and they have been stomping all over the other Sitar Hero players. I need you to show them that, no matter how many Sitar Heroes they have, they can never beat a Dungeon Runner.

You will find two of these Sitar Heroes in Mutanous Malaise, Level 2. When you have wiped them off of the Leaderboards, return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, here in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Turn-in:

Fantastic job. Those creatures never had a clue what hit them. I overheard them talking as they were walking back from the graveyard and they couldn't stop talking about you.

Objectives:

  • 100%_3vi1
  • RiffMaster2020
